title: fix: set reported issue quest reward to 3 Pollen
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reduces new issue-reporter rewards from 4 to 3 Pollen.
- Updates the quest description and test expectation.
- Already recorded rewards keep their amounts.

gist.headline: Three Pollen for a report
gist.blurb: The reported-issue Quest now awards 3 Pollen for new rewards. Rewards already recorded keep their original amounts; the ledger has a memory.
gist.summary: Set new reported-issue Quest rewards to 3 Pollen instead of 4, and updated the quest description and test expectation while preserving amounts already recorded.
gist.impact: New reported-issue Quest rewards grant 3 Pollen; previously recorded rewards stay unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the reported-issue Quest as a small garden noticeboard with a card marked '3 Pollen' and three pollen tokens. Polli updates the card while a closed ledger represents previously recorded rewards staying as they were. There is no project-specific mascot beyond Polli.
gist.image_prompt: Polli, wearing a tiny bookkeeper's visor, pins a '3 Pollen' reported-issue Quest card beside three golden tokens on a garden noticeboard, with a closed ledger and little flowers nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, a prominent lime green (#ecf874) background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
